null_invariance_audit.centering_argument: The null is a Markov-1 parametric bootstrap fitted to the POOLED counts, so it is centered on the pooled transition-count matrix. Var_t(IFA_t) is a function of the PER-WAVE count matrices, which the pooled matrix does not determine (the pooled matrix is their sum; a sum does not fix the dispersion of its summands). The statistic is therefore NOT a function of the null's sufficient statistic, which is exactly the defect that made the C1 stationary design unrejectable. Empirical confirmation: the observed percentile reported here is not pinned to the null centre.
